problem: 「诸法无我」译作 “non-self”，未用规范 §2／§5 的定型译法 “all dharmas are without self”；本节点引文 sources[0].en_q 亦作 “all dharmas are non-self.”。
zh_source: 「诸行无常，诸行是苦，诸法[[anatta|无我]]。」

problem: 「诸法无我」在本节点两处正文及三处引文一律作 “non-self”（正文另一处为 “all formations are impermanent, all formations are suffering, all dharmas are non-self”；引文作 “all [[nonself_seal|dharmas are non-self]]”“Are all dharmas non-self?”“all dharmas are [[anatta|non-self]]”），规范定型译法为 “all dharmas are without self”。
zh_source: 「诸法[[nonself_seal|无我]]」

problem: 引文「一切法无我」译作 “All dharmas are non-self.”，应依规范作 “All dharmas are without self.”（本节点标题概念即「诸法无我」）。
zh_source: 「一切[[nonself_seal|法无我]]。」

problem: 「三十七道品」译作 “the thirty-seven factors of enlightenment”，规范 §2 作 “the thirty-seven aids to enlightenment”（“factors of enlightenment” 通常指七觉支，易混）。
zh_source: 八正道是[[thirty_seven_bodhipakkhiya|三十七道品]]的中枢
current: the hub of the thirty-seven factors of enlightenment
suggested: the hub of the thirty-seven aids to enlightenment

problem: 「三十七道品」译作 “the thirty-seven factors of enlightenment”，规范 §2 作 “the thirty-seven aids to enlightenment”。
zh_source: 后世论书整理[[thirty_seven_bodhipakkhiya|三十七道品]]时的标准分类
current: in arranging the thirty-seven factors of enlightenment
suggested: in arranging the thirty-seven aids to enlightenment

problem: 「三十七道品」译作 “thirty-seven factors of enlightenment”，规范 §2 作 “the thirty-seven aids to enlightenment”。
zh_source: 正精进在[[thirty_seven_bodhipakkhiya|三十七道品]]中被反复强调

problem: 「四念处」译作 “four foundations of mindfulness”，规范 §2 作 “the four establishments of mindfulness”；同节点 sources[0].en_q 亦作 “the four foundations of mindfulness”。
zh_source: 即[[four_foundations|四念处]]的实践

problem: 「四禅八定」译作 “the four dhyānas and eight meditative attainments”，规范 §2 作 “the four dhyānas and eight concentrations”。
zh_source: 即[[four_dhyanas|四禅八定]]等

problem: 「十二因缘」译作 “twelvefold dependent origination”，规范 §2 作 “the twelve links of dependent origination”；同段下文又作 “the twelvefold chain”。
zh_source: 也是[[twelve_links|十二因缘]]的第八支「爱」

problem: 「十二因缘」译作 “the twelvefold chain”，规范 §2 作 “the twelve links of dependent origination”。
zh_source: 也是十二因缘的第一支
current: the first link of the twelvefold chain
suggested: the first link of the twelve links of dependent origination

problem: 「十二处」译作 “twelve sense-fields”，规范 §2 作 “the twelve sense bases”。
zh_source: 以[[five_aggregates|五蕴]]、[[twelve_ayatana|十二处]]、十八界分析经验
current: the [[twelve_ayatana|twelve sense-fields]] and the eighteen elements
suggested: the [[twelve_ayatana|twelve sense bases]] and the eighteen elements

problem: 「主（自在）」的「自在」译作 “self-existent”（self-existent 义为「自有、独立存在」）；自在应作 autonomous／at will，本库他处「不自主」即作 autonomous。同节点 nonself_seal 的同一四义亦作 “self-existent”。
zh_source: 常（常恒不变）、一（独立不依他）、主（自在）、宰（支配）四义

problem: 《中论》梵名作 “Madhyamaka-kārikā”，规范 §4 及本节点出处栏（sources[0].en）均作 “Mūlamadhyamakakārikā”，全库他处亦同。
zh_source: 这一表述后来在《中论》中被扩展为「八不」中的一对

problem: 《法华经·方便品》章名正文作 “Skillful Means”，而同节点出处栏 sources[2].en 作 “Expedient Means”，全库通行亦作 “Expedient Means”，前后不一。
zh_source: 《妙法莲华经·方便品》称「实相印」

problem: 「择灭无为」未用通行译名 analytical cessation（pratisaṃkhyā-nirodha），而作解释性短语 “cessation through discernment, the unconditioned”（sources[1].en_q 同此；nirvana 节点亦同）。
zh_source: 于无为法作「择灭无为」
current: it is cessation through discernment, the unconditioned
suggested: it is analytical cessation, the unconditioned (pratisaṃkhyā-nirodha)

problem: 「择灭无为」未用通行译名 analytical cessation（pratisaṃkhyā-nirodha），而作解释性短语 “cessation through discernment, the unconditioned”。
zh_source: 在无为法中即择灭无为
current: among the unconditioned dharmas it is cessation through discernment, the unconditioned
suggested: among the unconditioned dharmas it is analytical cessation, the unconditioned (pratisaṃkhyā-nirodha)

problem: 出处栏 sources[1].en 在中文所无之处擅自增补卷次：中文仅作《大智度论》卷19、《瑜伽师地论》，英译却作 “fascicle 22”（卷22 见于同节点 sources[3] 的中文，非此条）。
zh_source: 《大智度论》卷19、《瑜伽师地论》

problem: 「义为集起、生起、招感、根源」中的「招感」（招引果报）译作 “accumulation”，而 accumulation 系「集起」之义；段首 “The arising, root and accumulation of suffering.”（←「苦的生起、根源与招感」）同样把「招感」作 accumulation，未译出招引果报一义。
zh_source: 义为集起、生起、招感、根源
current: it means arising together, origination, accumulation and root
suggested: it means arising together, origination, the bringing about of result, and root

problem: 「愁悲忧恼苦」为四词，英译只作 “grief, sorrow and distress” 三项，「忧」漏译。
zh_source: 生苦、老苦、病苦、死苦、愁悲忧恼苦……
current: the suffering of grief, sorrow and distress
suggested: the suffering of grief, sorrow, anxiety and distress

problem: 出处栏 sources[1].en 书名后引号错配：结尾用了左引号 “ （U+201C），应为右引号 ”。
zh_source: 《中阿含经》卷24 第98经〈念处经〉
